name: RTX 5090 llama.cpp: gpt-oss 20B Q4_K_XL decode at 4k ctx (Hardware Corner)
methodology: Hardware Corner (Allan Witt) llama-bench build 466c1911 on RTX 5090 32GB GDDR7 (EPYC 7642 host, Ubuntu 24.04). gpt-oss 20B Q4_K_XL, -fa 1 -ngl 99, -p 1024/2048 -n 128 at context depth 4k. Per-request batch-1, NOT aggregate.
notes: PP at same ctx: 9443.81 t/s. Full ctx sweep 4k..131k in source.
